name: Vote Instruction 6 Code
definition: Specifies a type of voting instructions.

ABST.name: Abstain
ABST.definition: Active vote expressed as abstain (no opinion).

AMGT.name: Against Management
AMGT.definition: Vote instruction is in against the voting recommendations of the management.

BLNK.name: Blank
BLNK.definition: Vote is cast as empty but the vote is counted.

CHRM.name: Chairman
CHRM.definition: Rights holder gives authority to the chairman to vote on his behalf.

DISC.name: Discretionary
DISC.definition: Voting party is assigned discretionary right to vote for one resolution.

CFOR.name: For
CFOR.definition: Vote in favour of a meeting resolution.

ONEY.name: One Year
ONEY.definition: Vote in favour for one year for "say on pay" type of resolution.

THRY.name: Three Years
THRY.definition: Vote in favour for three years for "say on pay" type of resolution.

TWOY.name: Two Years
TWOY.definition: Vote in favour for two years for "say on pay" type of resolution.

WTHH.name: Withhold
WTHH.definition: Participant to a meeting withholds its vote for a meeting resolution. This action is usually taken in order to indicate a strong disagreement with a resolution (US market).

WMGT.name: With Management
WMGT.definition: Vote instruction is in line with the voting recommendations of the management.
